title: Write, compile, and run a C program
prompt:
The board is already reachable over SSH (MOSS_DEVICE_*). Work only under {{ROOT}}.

Write {{ROOT}}/hello.c, compile it to {{ROOT}}/hello with gcc or cc, and make {{ROOT}}/hello print a line that contains `moss-bench-c-ok {{TOKEN}}`. Record evidence metric `program_stdout` whose observed value is that program's stdout, trimmed.

Do not install packages. Do not reboot, reflash, change passwords, or edit ssh or network configuration. The bench deletes {{ROOT}} afterwards.
oracle: if command -v gcc >/dev/null; then gcc -o "$MOSS_BENCH_ROOT/hello" "$MOSS_BENCH_ROOT/hello.c"; else cc -o "$MOSS_BENCH_ROOT/hello" "$MOSS_BENCH_ROOT/hello.c"; fi
